Support for XLVAN and MPLS in Marvell AC5 Series Chips
1. XLVAN (eXtended VLAN)
+ ACS series does not natively support XLVAN, but similar functionality can be achieved
using QinQ (802.1ad) or VLAN Stacking.
‧ Models such as 98DX226S / 98DX336S support dual VLAN tagging (QinQ), which allows
VLAN extension.
2. MPLS (Multi-Protocol Label Switching)
‧ MPLS is not supported in the ACS series.
。 Marvell's switching chips generally do not provide native MPLS support. If MPLS is required,
it typically needs to be handled by an external routing processor (such as an ARM core)
or a separate PE router for encapsulation/decapsulation.
Conclusion:
@ XLVAN functionality can be implemented using QinQ / VLAN Stacking, which is supported
by AC5 chips.
X MPLS requires additional software or hardware support, as it is not natively supported in
the ACS series.
For MPLS VPN or MPLS-TP, you may need a higher-end switching chip, such as Marvell
ACS5X / Prestera CX series or Broadcom StrataDNX series.
